headings.h1_classes: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-white
headings.h2_classes: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use col-span-2 or col-span-3 for main visualizers, col-span-1 for stats/feed.
layout_and_spacing.wizard_layout: Bento split layout. Left side (col-span-4) for input/controls. Right side (col-span-8) for dynamic sticky real-time preview.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers must have internal padding. Use gap-8 or gap-12 in bento layouts.
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Cardless or sharp-edged. maximum rounded-md (6px-8px). Flat solid backgrounds (bg-[#121214]) with 1px solid border (border-white/10). No soft shadows, use 1px inner highlights if needed.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-md), intense colors. Primary: bg-[#F23F42] hover:bg-[#FF5C5E] text-white. Secondary: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/10.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. bg-[#0A0A0A], border-white/10, text-white, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#F23F42] focus:border-[#F23F42].
components.wizard_progress: Top-aligned or left-aligned step indicators. Use glowing red (#F23F42) for active state, muted zinc (#52525B) for inactive.
components.video_player: Must be contained within a 16:9 aspect ratio container with bg-black/50, centered play icon in red, with a sleek timeline at the bottom.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Buttons must explicitly change text color and background. Cards get a subtle border color shift to border-white/30 and -translate-y-[2px].
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use Framer Motion for step transitions in wizard (slide left/right with fade).
interactions_and_motion.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers or overlay modals. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.

hero_backgrounds.description: Projector light beams illuminate an empty cinema auditorium - use as atmospheric overlay with low opacity
Abstract glowing squares on a dark background - use for feature section background

Woman creator portrait - use for user profile or testimonials

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the layout entirely using Tailwind CSS, no standard Bootstrap grids. Ensure full-page sections utilize 'min-h-screen' and dark background '#0A0A0B'.
The step-by-step wizard is the core interaction. Split the screen: Left for settings/inputs, Right for a sticky video preview timeline.
In the wizard, use Framer Motion for smooth slide transitions between steps.
DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans fonts for headings. Inject Cabinet Grotesk (headings) and IBM Plex Sans (body) via Google Fonts or custom imports in index.html.
Ensure the hero section on the landing page has an atmospheric, cinematic overlay (max opacity bg-black/50) over the background image.
For all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, wizard steps), add data-testid attributes.
Use Shadcn UI for standard inputs, selects, tabs, and tables, but customize their styling to remove the 'Vercel look' (remove soft shadows, use 1px sharp borders and flat dark backgrounds).
Keep spacing wide (p-8, p-12) to match the premium creator tool aesthetic.
